text:
The dish looks like a white plate of roughly 26 cm across. The food is hash browns topped with pico de gallo and green salsa, and it covers only part of the plate, about 12-15 cm across.

The layer is fairly thin. I estimate about 150 g of hash browns, which were probably cooked with oil, plus about 50 g of salsa and pico. That gives roughly 200 g in total.

Hash browns run about 1.5-2 kcal/g when pan-fried, so 150 g is about 270 kcal. The salsa adds about 20 kcal, for a total of roughly 290 kcal.
